title: Oak Ridge magnesium-bismuth technical document
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Oak Ridge magnesium-bismuth technical document, about 1950s at Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Tennessee, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaking in an episode about a US Secretary of Energy and UFOs, says that among documents on UFOs there is a 1950s technical paper from Oak Ridge National Laboratory, a government nuclear research lab in Tennessee. He says the paper talks about the metals magnesium and bismuth. He mentions it because, if true, it would tie a government lab to materials he connects with UFOs.
